content.text: Prophylaxis: a-fib pt -prevent CVA or embolism
▪︎PE, stable pts: heparin + a DOAC or warfarin
▪︎protein C def: DOACs more commonly used for typical VTE presentations
▪︎TIA/stroke prevention (AFib, intracardiac thrombus, ACS, prosthetic ♡ valve, VTE); more convenient than warfarin (no INR monitoring)
Monitoring: None: drug levels are predictable
PAD: 2.5mg BID + ASA 81 (dual-pathway inhib; only DOAC w FDA-approved PAD indication)
MOA: direct, selective, reversible inhib of free + clot-bound factor Xa -> ⇣platelet activation + fibrin clot formation
ARISTOTLE: apixaban superior to warfarin (stroke/systemic embolism, major bleeding, all-cause mortality); most pts → DOAC over warfarin (⇣bleeding risk)

Boxed warning: premature d/c of any oral anticoagulant ⇡thrombotic events - if stopped for a reason other than pathological bleeding or completion of tx, cover w another anticoagulant; spinal/epidural hematoma
: bind directly to Xa, preventing conversion of prothrombin to thrombin, ending the rest of the coag cascade → prevents clot form
MOA: Compete w Cl in Na/K/2Cl cotransport ->⍉ reabsorb
↓ preload (↓ vol) & ↓ afterload (NO -dilator) b/c most Na reabsorb
Clin Use: ↑efficacy diuretic & remove Na/Cl from body->↑↑↑ urine
Pulm edema, periph edema, HTN: ↓ fluid
Only drug in HFthat can ↓ current vol overload
▪︎HFrEF: relieve Sx + signs of vol overload; ⍉shown to ⇣mortality
Acute Renal Failure: ↓ vol so kidney work less
Anion OD: Reabsorb bicarb since ⍉ rebabsorb Cl
Acute HF -> fast act -decompensated acute HF<-vol overload
Aortic regurg: diuresis for vol overload (limited role: pre-op/⍉surgical)
Administration: can be based on pt daily wt
Ototoxicity:↑w aminoglycoside, ↑dose, rapid IV admin, ethacrynic acid
Acute hypovolemia: rapid ↓ vol -> hypotension, shock, arrhythmia
Also AE: dizziness, rash, ↑cholesterol, anorexia, urinary bladder spasm, blurred vision
Efficacy- improve S/Sx edema and/or BP
•block sodium/Cl reabsorb in the thick ascending loop of Henle by interfering w/ the chloride-binding co-transport system
•increases excretion of Na, K, Cl, Mg, Ca, & H2O
: ⍉mortality benefit in HF pts; used to relieve sxs related to congestion/edema
: ↓ Na, K, Cl, Mg, Ca, hyperuricemia, ↑BG, ↑TG/total cholest, orthostatic hypotension, photosensitivity, ↑urination
